description: Returns the manifest for the latest or specified deployment run, including artifact kinds, keys, sizes, row counts, timestamps, symbols, queryability, visibility, and upload status. Use this to find the canonical agent_detail and memory artifacts before asking why a live or scheduled bot made a decision. For scheduled AI-agent strategies, verify agent_detail plus memory_events, memory_retrievals, and memory_state are present to confirm tool usage, thinking/token telemetry, and memory persistence between runs.
name: list_deployment_artifacts
title: List artifacts for a deployment run
